theme_and_archetype.archetype: Organic & Earthy (Modified for Premium Soft-Tech Healthcare)
theme_and_archetype.vibe: Calm, premium, trustworthy, clear, non-fear-based, decision engine

descriptions.Warm Ivory: Main background (#FCFAF8 or close). Gives the clinical space a warm, hospitable feel.
descriptions.Soft Turquoise / Blue-Green: Primary CTA and active states (#2A9D8F). Calming healthcare trust tone.
descriptions.Deep Slate/Charcoal: Text color (#1E2925). Softer than pure black for a premium look.
descriptions.Sky Blue-Green: Accent and secondary surfaces. Used in Care Pass teaser.

headline.family: Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, or similar premium Serif
headline.usage: H1, H2, H3 - To match the Care Pass aesthetic and provide a trustworthy, authoritative but elegant medical tone

body.family: Manrope, Inter, or similar clean Geometric/Humanist Sans

section_by_section_treatment.name: 1. Premium Sticky Navigation
section_by_section_treatment.visuals: Crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl with light ivory tint). Clean layout: Logo on left, subtle nav links center, 'Провери своя случай' CTA button on right.
section_by_section_treatment.motion: Slide down on scroll up, slight shadow increase when scrolled.

section_by_section_treatment.name: 2. Hero Section
section_by_section_treatment.visuals: Spacious split layout (or bento-hero). Left: Large serif headline, sans-serif subheadline, dual CTAs. Right: Floating product UI cards (mockup of the quiz/results) casting soft ambient shadows. Use the `hero_background_texture` image as a very subtle, low-opacity background overlay.
section_by_section_treatment.motion: Staggered fade-up for text. Floating, gentle levitation animation (Y-axis translate) for the UI cards to feel 'soft-tech'.

section_by_section_treatment.name: 3. Trust Strip
section_by_section_treatment.visuals: Horizontal, muted flex-wrap or slow marquee bar. Minimalist icons (lucide-react) paired with text. Minimal contrast, text-sm, uppercase/tracking-wide.

section_by_section_treatment.name: 4. Problem Section
section_by_section_treatment.visuals: Full-width section with a soft turquoise/blue-green muted background (--secondary or --accent). Focuses on patient confusion. Use large, elegant typography. Clean layout with plenty of negative space.

section_by_section_treatment.name: 5. How it Works (4 Steps)
section_by_section_treatment.visuals: 4 connected steps or cards using a horizontal track or grid. 'Отговори → Разбери → Сравни → Заяви насочване'. High emphasis on clarity. Use numeric indicators with soft circles.

section_by_section_treatment.name: 6. Treatment Category Cards
section_by_section_treatment.visuals: A clean grid (e.g., 3x2 or 4x2 bento layout) of rounded cards with soft shadows. White background on cards against ivory section background.

section_by_section_treatment.name: 7. Interactive Decision Preview UI
section_by_section_treatment.visuals: A centralized, large mockup card mimicking the actual app result screen. Clean, data-rich but visually calm. Use subtle glassmorphism if overlapping backgrounds.

section_by_section_treatment.name: 8. Zubi Guidance Section
section_by_section_treatment.visuals: Introduce the AI-native guide. Use the `zubi_ai_abstract` image (holographic/orb). NO face, NO childish mascot. Calm, intelligent narrative.
section_by_section_treatment.motion: Slow, continuous rotation or breathing scale animation on the holographic orb.

section_by_section_treatment.name: 9. Clinic Matching Explanation
section_by_section_treatment.visuals: Text-heavy but highly scannable section explaining the guided matching vs random directory. Use abstract UI connectors or line-art icons.

section_by_section_treatment.name: 10. Patient Questions / Education Cards
section_by_section_treatment.visuals: Carousel or grid of simple, rounded cards addressing common doubts.

section_by_section_treatment.name: 11. Optional Care Pass Teaser
section_by_section_treatment.visuals: Match existing premium ivory/sky palette. Looks like an exclusive membership card or premium invite.
section_by_section_treatment.motion: Subtle metallic/shine sweep effect on hover.

section_by_section_treatment.name: 12. FAQ
section_by_section_treatment.visuals: Clean Shadcn accordion. No borders, just soft dividers. Serif typography for questions.

section_by_section_treatment.name: 13. Final CTA & Footer
section_by_section_treatment.visuals: Centered, high-impact section. Repeated CTA buttons. Calm background. Medical disclaimer in muted small text at the bottom.

motion_language.philosophy: Smooth, calm, deliberate. No rapid snapping. High-end 'momentum' feel.
motion_language.hover_states: -translate-y-1 with expanded soft shadow. Text color shift to primary.
motion_language.scroll_triggers: Framer motion (or Tailwind group-fade) staggered entrances for grids.
motion_language.floating_ui: Infinite Y-axis float (animation-duration: 6s, ease-in-out) for hero mockups.

responsive_breakpoints.mobile: Mobile-first. Hero mockups scale down to static cards or hide completely to prioritize the CTA. Sticky CTA fixed at bottom of screen on mobile.
responsive_breakpoints.desktop: Generous max-width (e.g., max-w-6xl). Mockups overlap sections to create depth.

anti_patterns: NO cyberpunk, neon, or harsh borders.
NO childish mascots (Zubi is an abstract/calm guide).
NO generic dental stock photos (smiling people pointing at teeth).
NO purple gradients. Stick to ivory/turquoise.
NO aggressive 'Book Now' language. Use 'request guidance' variations.
NO center-everything disease. Use asymmetric bento grids and left-aligned text for readability.
NO pure black/white combinations. Tint greys and whites with warmth.

image_urls.description: Subtle organic grain texture, warm ivory background with very soft, diffuse turquoise. Use as a low-opacity overlay or background in the Hero and Problem sections.
Calm, premium abstract 3D shape/orb. Use in the 'Zubi Guidance' section to represent the AI guide without using a face/mascot.

hero_headline: Разбери какво ти има, преди да седнеш на стола.
hero_subheadline: Zubite.bg ти помага да разбереш своя стоматологичен проблем и те насочва към правилния специалист — без объркване.
Вашият личен навигатор в денталното здраве. Получете яснота за състоянието си и намерете най-подходящата клиника.
medical_disclaimer: Zubite.bg не поставя диагнози и не замества професионален стоматологичен преглед. Платформата предоставя само ориентировъчна информация.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT ADD UNNECESSARY DEPENDENCIES. Use Tailwind and Shadcn UI (already present in Next.js app).
Replace the content of /app/frontend/app/page.tsx or create a new layout, but DO NOT break existing routes (/quiz, /blog, /admin, etc.).
Construct the Hero section with a heavy emphasis on HTML/CSS 'Mockup Cards' floating on the right to simulate the product UI, avoiding generic images.
Implement the Serif headline + Sans-serif body typography pairing globally on the homepage.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Implement a mobile sticky CTA that remains visible on small screens to drive conversions.
Always rely on the generated media URLs provided in this file; NO placeholders.
